assets.note: Adapted for the requested determinate scroll indicator: closed circle, preserving the Nordic 24px size, 2.5px stroke and primary blue. A 2px arc is visible at twelve o'clock from zero progress; CSS extends it with scrolling. The indeterminate approval-stage loader is unchanged.
